scope: Private collaborative album photo upload, URL resolution and account isolation
verified: Private object paths include uploader and album identity; traversal is rejected
Original and preview must both upload successfully; partial failures cannot report success
Account changes stop subsequent uploads and cannot clean up through another account
Persisted album references use private supabase URIs
Same-project legacy public URLs are resolved through current authorized signing
Album image signing requests expire in at most 60 seconds
Late signing responses cannot populate a new account cache
A new account cannot reuse a previous account image signing cache or pending request
Cleanup skips foreign paths, referenced objects and another account session

rls_enabled_no_policy.reason: Three private bookkeeping tables deliberately deny direct client access

limits: A previously issued signed URL remains valid until expiry; downloaded copies cannot be recalled
No connected physical phone was available; installation and physical-device execution are not claimed
